title: Drawing Organic Molecules: Four Ways
subject: Chemistry
chapter: Organic Chemistry – Some Basic Principles and Techniques
objective: One butane molecule, four ways to write it: complete, condensed, bond-line and 3D. How to read each, and how to count what a zigzag hides.

ar.a: Bond-line formulas leave out H atoms on carbon.
ar.r: Carbon's 4 bonds tell us how many H atoms there are.

ar.a: But-1-ene has 2 fewer H atoms than butane.
ar.r: A double bond uses 2 of carbon's bonds on one neighbour.
